title: Story of Prophet Adam (AS)
details: Adam (AS) was the first man created by Allah from clay. He was taught the names of all things. Allah commanded the angels to prostrate to him; all did except Iblis (Satan), who refused out of pride. Adam and his wife Hawa (Eve) lived in Jannah but were forbidden from eating from a specific tree. Iblis deceived them, and they were sent to Earth. Adam (AS) repented and was forgiven, becoming the first Prophet.

title: Story of Prophet Nuh (Noah) (AS)
details: Nuh (AS) preached for 950 years, calling his people to the worship of one Allah. Only a few followed him. Allah commanded him to build an Ark. When the Great Flood came, Nuh (AS), the believers, and pairs of every animal were saved, while the disbelievers, including his own son and wife, perished.

title: Story of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) (AS)
details: Known as Khalilullah (Friend of Allah), Ibrahim (AS) is a central figure in Islam. He rejected the idol worship of his father and people. He was thrown into a fire by Nimrod, but Allah made the fire cool and safe for him. He built the Kaaba in Mecca with his son Ismail (AS) and is the patriarch of many prophets through his sons Ismail and Ishaq.

title: Story of Prophet Musa (Moses) (AS)
details: Musa (AS) was sent to Pharaoh to free the Children of Israel. He was given miracles like the staff that turned into a serpent and the parting of the Red Sea. He received the Torah (Tawrat) on Mount Sinai. He is the prophet mentioned most frequently in the Quran.

title: Story of Prophet Isa (Jesus) (AS)
details: Isa (AS) was born miraculously to Maryam (Mary) without a father. He spoke in the cradle and performed miracles like healing the blind and raising the dead by Allah's permission. He received the Gospel (Injil). Islam teaches that he was not crucified but raised to heaven by Allah and will return before the Day of Judgment.

title: Story of Prophet Muhammad (SAW)
details: The final Prophet and Messenger of Allah. Born in Mecca, he received the first revelation of the Quran at age 40 in the Cave of Hira. He faced persecution in Mecca and migrated to Medina (the Hijra). He established the first Islamic state and completed the message of Islam for all humanity.
